note: Empty programming pulses (H6): largest |V| across a device (row 0 selected, row 1 not), largest current from VPRG, and the read-conductance drift toward the read reference (HRS up, LRS down) from the device model over each waveform (empty_pulse_gap.py). A row is re-verified when it is programmed, so the selected row's drift counts per command (42 steps); a row written once drifts while the 71 other rows are programmed (42 x 71 steps per full-array write). The device is a linear resistor in the deck and the cell transistors have no junction areas, so coupling may be underestimated; uniform columns only.
criterion: per condition: selected-row drift per command < 1 % and other-row full-array writes to 10 % >= 10 x planned
